messages:
Diego R: Hey team — sorry to drop this on Slack but I had a pretty bad allergic reaction in the office yesterday (headache, sneezing, eye irritation). My doctor says it's likely fragrance-related. Is there a way to request a scent-free seating area or temporary relocation? I can work remote but would prefer coming in when necessary.

Priya K: Oh no, Diego. Glad you're okay. We can absolutely help. Do you want me to stop by your desk and check for obvious sources? Also happy to work with People Ops to request a nearby desk swap.

Diego R: Thanks Priya. I think it was from that coworker two desks down who sometimes sprays perfume. I don't want to make it awkward, just need a practical fix.

Jordan T: Hey Diego 94 I meant no harm; I was testing a new cologne, didn't realize it would bother you. Sorry about that. I'm fine moving my stuff if that helps.

Sasha (People Ops): Hi all 94 thanks for flagging. Diego, we can open an ADA accommodation intake for fragrance sensitivity. Options we usually offer: desk relocation to a low-traffic scent-free zone, HEPA air purifier loaner, and a formal request message sent to the nearby team to ask for fragrance reduction in shared spaces. Which would you like to start with?

Diego R: Desk relocation + purifier please. Also would like a short note to be added to my accommodation file that this is temporary until we find a long-term seating plan. Not looking for anything punitive toward Jordan.

Priya K: I'll block off two desks on the same floor for consideration. Jordan, if you're open to moving we can make it quick. If not, Facilities can do a temporary partition or purifier placement.

Jordan T: I'm happy to move. No problem.

Facilities Bot: Facilities ticket created: #FAC-9982. Action: evaluate nearby desks, confirm availability, and arrange cart move if approved. ETA 2 business days.

Sasha (People Ops): Diego, please DM me a brief clinician note (can be one line) or email people-ops@redwood.com so we can document the accommodation. We'll mark it confidential and route only to People Ops + your manager. Also, we'll draft a neutral, non-blaming desk-adjacent notice about scent policies to share with the section if you want.

Diego R: I'll send the note now. Thank you. And yes, I'd appreciate a neutral heads-up note rather than calling anyone out.

HR Bot: Accommodation record opened: ACC-2026. Items requested: desk relocation, HEPA purifier. Privacy flag: confidential.

Sasha (People Ops): Noted. Priya, can you confirm operational coverage for Diego if the relocation requires a brief partial remote day? We want to avoid any impact on his performance review; we'll flag that in the accommodation record.

Priya K: Confirmed. Diego can go remote for the rest of the day to recover and we'll redistribute any urgent reviews. I'll add a calendar note and update the team rota. No performance action tied to this.

Diego R: Really appreciate the fast response. Means a lot.

Sasha (People Ops): Follow-ups: Facilities will propose desk options in FAC-9982, People Ops will send the accommodation agreement template for signature, and we'll schedule a 1-week check-in to make sure the purifier/desk works. Everyone: thank you for being flexible.

Jordan T: Again, sorry Diego. I'll pack up now.

Diego R: Thanks Jordan. And thanks everyone :pray:
